diff --git a/tests/test_websockets.py b/tests/test_websockets.py
index c97173f..1661096 100644
--- a/tests/test_websockets.py
+++ b/tests/test_websockets.py
@@ -11,7 +11,7 @@ from starlette import status
 from starlette.responses import FileResponse, Response, StreamingResponse
 from starlette.testclient import WebSocketDenialResponse
 from starlette.types import Message, Receive, Scope, Send
-from starlette.websockets import WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, WebSocketState
+from starlette.websockets import WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, WebSocketDisconnected, WebSocketState
 from tests.types import TestClientFactory
 
 
@@ -651,3 +651,61 @@ def test_receive_wrong_message_type(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> N
     with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
         with client.websocket_connect("/") as websocket:
             websocket.send({"type": "websocket.connect"})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_disconnected_websocket_operations() -> None:
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "websocket.disconnect", "code": 1000}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    websocket = WebSocket({"type": "websocket", "path": "/"}, receive, send)
+    websocket.client_state = WebSocketState.DISCONNECTED
+    websocket.application_state = WebSocketState.DISCONNECTED
+
+    assert issubclass(WebSocketDisconnected, RuntimeError)
+    with pytest.raises(
+        WebSocketDisconnected,
+        match='Cannot call "receive" once a disconnect message has been received.',
+    ):
+        await websocket.receive()
+    with pytest.raises(WebSocketDisconnected, match='Cannot call "send" once a close message has been sent.'):
+        await websocket.send({"type": "websocket.send", "text": "message"})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("helper", ["receive_text", "receive_bytes", "receive_json"])
+async def test_receive_helpers_on_disconnected_application_side(helper: str) -> None:
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "websocket.disconnect", "code": 1000}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    websocket = WebSocket({"type": "websocket", "path": "/"}, receive, send)
+    websocket.application_state = WebSocketState.DISCONNECTED
+
+    with pytest.raises(WebSocketDisconnected, match='WebSocket is not connected. Need to call "accept" first.'):
+        await getattr(websocket, helper)()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_receive_helper_errors_remain_distinct() -> None:
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "websocket.disconnect", "code": 1000}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    websocket = WebSocket({"type": "websocket", "path": "/"}, receive, send)
+    websocket.application_state = WebSocketState.DISCONNECTED
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc:
+        await websocket.receive_json(mode="invalid")
+    assert type(exc.value) is RuntimeError
+
+    websocket.application_state = WebSocketState.CONNECTED
+    websocket.client_state = WebSocketState.CONNECTED
+    with pytest.raises(WebSocketDisconnect):
+        await websocket.receive_text()
